name: publicWeb_getKennelRunsFeed
description: Everything a kennel's iCal feed (/<slug>/runs.ics, E3.F6.S8) needs in one call: a header row for the kennel and its visible, live runs from 30 days ago onwards (EventStartDatetimeGmt), oldest first, at most 500. Its own procedure rather than a reuse of publicWeb_getEvents (James, 2026-10-15): calendar apps read the feed constantly, so it returns only the columns the calendar writes (one unique-index seek on the slug, one seek on IX_Event_Kennel_GmtStart_Visible, ~45 page reads for a typical kennel), and a change made for the site's run lists cannot change the feed by accident. Defunct (-1) and Inactive-Hidden (4) kennels return the header with FeedActive = 0 and no runs, so subscribers' calendars empty rather than error; a kennel with its website switched off still has a feed (its run pages still render). Public fields only — the same ones the public run pages show. No authentication (anonymous PublicWebApi GET). Read-only. The web caches the answer 15 minutes per kennel.

parameters.name: kennelUniqueShortName
parameters.description: The kennel's URL slug. No match among live kennels → rowset 0 is empty (shim 404).

rowsets.name: KennelFeedHeader
rowsets.description: One row, or EMPTY when no live kennel has this slug (the shim answers 404).

columns.name: KennelName
columns.description: Calendar name: '<KennelName> runs'.

columns.name: KennelShortName
columns.description: Prefix of each run's summary ('DH3 #1683').

columns.name: CustomDomain
columns.description: HC.KennelWebsite.CustomDomain; when set, run links use it instead of www.hashruns.org/<slug>.

columns.name: KennelIANATimezone
columns.description: IANA zone of the kennel's city, for the gather / pack-off times in each description. NULL when the city has no zone.

columns.name: FeedActive
columns.description: 1 normally; 0 for a Defunct (-1) or Inactive-Hidden (4) kennel, whose rowset 1 is then empty.

rowsets.name: FeedRuns
rowsets.description: Visible, live runs (IsVisible = 1, deleted = 0, removed = 0) with EventStartDatetimeGmt no more than 30 days ago, ascending, TOP 500. Empty when FeedActive = 0.

columns.name: PublicEventId
columns.description: Lower-case public id; the iCal UID is '<id>@hashruns.org', so it must never change for a run (rotating it re-creates the entry).

columns.name: EventNumber
columns.description: Run number; the run's page is /<slug>/<EventNumber>.

columns.name: EventName
columns.description: Run name.

columns.name: EventStartDatetimeGmt
columns.description: The start instant (UTC) — DTSTART. Never the raw EventStartDatetime (/hc-event-datetimes).

columns.name: EventStartLocal
columns.description: Wall-clock start; with EventEndLocal gives the run's length only.

columns.name: EventEndLocal
columns.description: Wall-clock end (EventEndDatetime, offset stripped). NULL = the feed uses 3 hours.

columns.name: PackOffMinutes
columns.description: Effective pack-off, minutes after the gather: the run's, else the kennel's (E3.F1.S6).

columns.name: Hares
columns.description: Hares as shown on the public run page.

columns.name: LocationOneLineDesc
columns.description: Preferred LOCATION text.

columns.name: LocationStreet
columns.description: SyncLocationStreet — LOCATION fallback.

columns.name: LocationCity
columns.description: SyncLocationCity — LOCATION fallback.

columns.name: LocationPostCode
columns.description: SyncLocationPostCode — LOCATION fallback.

columns.name: LocationCountry
columns.description: SyncLocationCountry — LOCATION fallback.

columns.name: Latitude
columns.description: SyncLatitude — GEO when in range.

columns.name: Longitude
columns.description: SyncLongitude — GEO when in range.

columns.name: EventDescription
columns.description: SyncDescription; the feed strips HTML and caps it at 2,000 characters.

columns.name: UpdatedAt
columns.description: HC.Event.updatedAt — LAST-MODIFIED; the latest across the feed is its DTSTAMP, so an unchanged feed has an unchanged body and ETag.

sideEffects: On a runtime error: one HC.ErrorLog row, then THROW.
breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
Never add a members-only field: the feed is public and cached
Keep PublicEventId stable per run: it is the calendar UID
